Current Position

Lincolnshire, IL

Marriott Theatre

Bassist & Music Coordinator

One of the largest subscription-based musical theater companies in the United States. As a bassist, Trevor performs in mainstage productions. As Music Coordinator, Trevor hires orchestras, ensures contract compliance, and manages musician payroll.

Currently performing Come From Away, August 26th through October 18th.

Symphonic Work (Selected Credits)

A celebrated regional orchestra founded in 1950 and named Orchestra of the Year four times by the Illinois Council of Orchestras, performing at the Hemmens Cultural Center in Elgin, IL.

Professional Symphony

A musician-governed orchestra founded by principals of the Lyric Opera Orchestra, drawing from nearly 200 of Chicago's top classical performers and named one of the country's finest symphonic orchestras by the Chicago Tribune.

Professional Symphony

One of the leading cultural institutions in Northern Illinois, founded in 1934 and the third largest orchestra in Illinois, performing at the historic Coronado Theatre in Rockford. Trevor was a member for several years.
